name: Barithras Moonshade
summary: In Auberdine, Barithras Moonshade seeks travelers to gather rare plants from Darkshore’s shadowed wilds.

sections.title: Resident of Auberdine
sections.body: Barithras Moonshade watches over Auberdine and helps the night elves study and care for Darkshore. He sends travelers into nearby caverns to gather fungi for study and use, including death cap mushrooms.

sections.title: Ties to the Ancients
sections.body: Barithras also guides capable travelers south to meet Onu. The ancient works to heal Darkshore’s tainted soil and soothe its restless natural spirits.

faq.answer: In Auberdine, Barithras Moonshade asks travelers to investigate local plants and contact guardians in the region.

faq.q: Where can I find Barithras Moonshade?
faq.answer: You can find Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine, the port settlement on Darkshore’s shore.
Barithras sends travelers into nearby caverns to gather fungi, including death cap mushrooms, then points them south to meet Onu.

faq.q: Is Barithras related to the other Moonshades?
aliases: is barithras related to sentinel moonshade
faq.answer: No relatives of Barithras are recorded, so any tie to other night elves named Moonshade is unknown.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can help your kin in Auberdine safeguard Darkshore by watching its plants and keeping ties with ancient forest guardians like Onu.
As one attuned to plant life, you may appreciate Barithras’s interest in Darkshore’s unusual cavern fungi.
